body.prose:
Questions the first mark meets, and those beyond it, each to be settled when the work reaches it.

- **How a component is found for a mount**: matched by type each time it draws, as now, or picked from a table of defaults and recorded in the mount, as OpenLight ruled, in [the interface](ref:01M6FDC1VG7W748B5N5FJVANDG). The author does not know yet; whatever is built on it is built knowing it may change.

- **What kind a slot is**: a contract between holder and held over a vocabulary of kinds, full and face, with the slot's own data first, as [the interface](ref:01M6FK1FKDZAATFH51A2094GAA) proposes. Taken provisionally; the author does not know it is right.

These two, how a component is found and what kind a slot is, are decisions whose rightness is not known: whatever would be built depending on either is named before it is built, so the author can weigh it.

- **The material.** How things look is held in the field as a holon of its own, a style sheet of named colours, type and spacing that every component draws with, so the chassis holds no style. It was built on 2026-11-03, named from the author's word for what one builds in; whether this decoupling serves, and whether the word should mean that or something wider, he does not know yet.

- **How a type's contract is written**, and how the engine checks a body against it at commit; that a holon's types are stored as its instance, and that each field is said in prose beside its shape, is settled.

- **Provenance.** A published commit says nothing of the run that made it, so only the runner's home knows; whether published history should say how it was made.

- **Events as holons.** Thousands of visits nobody edits or points at may be better as rows within one holon each day.

- **Whether a store ships its index** of references and values, or every engine builds it.

- **How a read is asked.** Glass reads by identity and by expressions of its functions; whether the engine plans an expression as one request, as OpenLight's does, is open.

- **Prose as typed parts**, as [knowledge](ref:01M6F8G0M08FRQKFFYH1H9M13B) leaves it.

- **Merging**, when two lines of commits meet, a question for peers.

- **The wholes of the field**, left open by the author on 2026-11-04 and gathered in [the relations](ref:01M6M9PESEZYMYD8KM3AB5ZEZ1): what makes a whole a dimension, how briefs hold their parts and prose made native, a single owner, whether a mount holds what it offers, how a bare name is found.

- **How a commit says which wholes it touched**, and which wholes keep an index of their own, as [the store](ref:01M6M9PESED8DSZJA9N8NQRRKX) leaves it.

- **What an integration owes the engine**, and how git in particular is integrated, as [the store](ref:01M6M9PESE307QYKEJVMRS5T8J) leaves it.

- **Who published, provably**: keys and signatures on what a store's ref points at.

- **When the shape of kept state changes**, as [the home](ref:01M6F8G0M04RHV275FW6CC13TC) says.

- **What site is built on glass**, which is not known yet and not needed for the foundation.

*Open, 2026-11-01.*
body.title: What is open
